## Activity

During January 2025, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 91 captures. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the reporting month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the period.

## Image quality

Of the 91 captures, 1 was ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.1 per cent. This indicates that nearly all images obtained during January 2025 were suitable for assessment. The ungradable result remains included in the site’s activity and quality measures.

## Grading

Grading identified 15 referable results from the completed captures. The median lag between image capture and grading was 6. This measure provides an indication of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process. Together, the activity, image quality and grading results provide a summary of Oakridge Primary Care’s operational performance for January 2025.
